title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - TrafficEventCause
description: Class of concepts describing traffic event causes (s4auto:TrafficEventCause, subclass of skos:Concept; adapted from ETSI TS 102 894-2 CauseCodeChoice/SubCauseCode). The vocabulary is large (161 named individuals in the v2.1.1 ontology: 20 top-level causes, each with several narrower sub-causes) and open-ended, so it is modeled here as an open/enumerated string rather than as ~160 separate data models (see translation notes). The 20 top-level causes are: TrafficCondition, Accident, Roadworks, Impassability, Aquaplaning, HumanPresenceOnTheRoad, WrongWayDriving, RescueAndRecoveryWorkInProgress, Violence, SlowVehicle, DangerousEndOfQueue, VehicleBreakdown, PostCrash, HumanProblem, StationaryVehicle, EmergencyVehicleApproaching, CollisionRisk, SignalViolation, DangerousSituation, RailwayLevelCrossing. Narrower causes follow the naming pattern '<TopLevelCause>_<narrowerCause>', e.g. 'Accident_accidentInvolvingBus' or 'TrafficCondition_trafficJamIncreasing'; see the full ETSI TS 103 410-7 / TS 102 894-2 specification for the exhaustive list.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'TrafficEventCause'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

category.description: Property. The top-level traffic event cause category this concept belongs to (or equals, if this is itself a top-level cause).

causeCode.description: Property. The specific (possibly narrower) traffic event cause term, e.g. 'Accident' or 'Accident_accidentInvolvingBus'. Open vocabulary; not exhaustively enumerated here (161 named individuals in the source ontology).

broaderCause.description: Relationship. The broader/parent TrafficEventCause concept, if this is a narrower cause (skos:broader).
